data.narrative:
Blackshark.ai is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $55M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, supplemented by reference to 2 public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $55M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage step-ups, yields $110M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comp set—which ranges from $125M to $3.0B—produces a $1.0B implied valuation, anchored on the median of same-sector peers at comparable or slightly later stages (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B).

The two methods produce divergent results, reflecting the wide dispersion in defense-tech valuations and stage-to-stage variance. A triangulated range of $94M (low) to $1.1B (high) with a median of $555M is supported by the data. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-adjustment discount relative to the Series B peer set and whether momentum in defense-sector funding justifies peer valuations or represents sector-specific premium.
